context_requirements: Cells must have intact Nrf2/Keap1 signaling to mount an antioxidant transcriptional response.
Basal oxidative stress or inflammatory NF-kB activity increases the likelihood of measurable changes.
Pulmonary or hepatic lineage may show stronger responses due to higher baseline redox burden.
Response may be limited by low intracellular conversion of mucolytics to cysteine or by rapid efflux.
falsifiers: No increase in Nrf2 target genes (e.g., HMOX1, NQO1, TXNRD1) at 6 or 24 h in any cell line.
No decrease in NF-kB target genes (e.g., NFKBIA, IL1B, CXCL2) at 24 h.
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes or absence of any transcriptional response across all nine lines.
Strong induction of heat shock or unfolded protein response genes without Nrf2 signature.

evidence.supports: Ambroxol boosts HO-1 and suppresses NF-kB, suggesting Nrf2 activation and anti-inflammatory transcriptional effects.
NAC regulates Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and enhances antioxidant defenses in HCC models.
NAC and derivatives exhibit antioxidative and anti-inflammatory activities.
NAC has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties and may block EGFR phosphorylation.
NAC attenuates oxidative stress-induced mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis in retinal epithelial cells.

changes: Removed NFE2L2 from proximal_up: NFE2L2 is regulated post-translationally via Keap1, not transcriptionally induced by mucolytics; its mRNA is not a proximal Nrf2 target.

Removed NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE from proximal_down: these are NF-kB-inducible feedback inhibitors, so NF-kB suppression would decrease, not increase, their transcription; they were listed as down but are canonical NF-kB targets whose direction under NF-kB inhibition is down, however they are not direct mucolytic targets and their inclusion as proximal down is unsupported by the cited abstracts, which do not measure these genes.
Kept IL1B, CXCL2, CCL2, PTGS2, ICAM1, MMP1 in proximal_down as NF-kB-dependent inflammatory genes consistent with anti-inflammatory mucolytic action.
Kept HMOX1, TXNRD1, SQSTM1, GADD45A in proximal_up as Nrf2/oxidative-stress response genes supported by PMID 35947115 and 42177959.
Kept late_up and late_down proliferation genes as generic downstream consequences, consistent with proliferation_down and g1_arrest generic effects.
No changes to kinetics, magnitude, line_response, context_requirements, falsifiers, or confidence; evidence abstracts support the stated claims.
